benchmark_seeds.target: incremental information about future revenue, margin, FCF and declared operating KPIs
benchmark_seeds.candidate_model: PIT primitive-driver decomposition with stable-definition routing and transparent arithmetic bridges
benchmark_seeds.pit_requirement: freeze filings, segment definitions, unit definitions and operational data exactly as available at each historical as_of
benchmark_seeds.oos_requirement: walk_forward issuer-quarter evaluation with no future taxonomy backfill
benchmark_seeds.regime_holdout: hold out at least one demand, supply, pricing or reporting-definition regime where feasible
benchmark_seeds.multiple_testing_risk: predeclare primary driver families and penalize post-hoc signal mining

benchmark_seeds.target: future earnings persistence, cash realization and false-alarm-adjusted statement integrity
benchmark_seeds.candidate_model: PIT three-statement reconciliation with cash/accrual decomposition, accrual reliability, working-capital and growth controls
benchmark_seeds.pit_requirement: preserve original filing dates, amended filings, restatement lineage and accounting-policy versions
benchmark_seeds.oos_requirement: walk-forward issuer-quarter evaluation with sector accounting profiles frozen before each test
benchmark_seeds.regime_holdout: hold out at least one rapid-growth, working-capital stress or accounting-policy transition regime
benchmark_seeds.multiple_testing_risk: predeclare accrual categories and primary persistence/cash-realization endpoints

benchmark_seeds.target: subsequent sector investment, default, crisis risk and recession severity conditional on balance-sheet state
benchmark_seeds.candidate_model: sectoral PIT credit-transmission state using borrower leverage/net worth, collateral, debt service, lending standards and funding cost
benchmark_seeds.pit_requirement: use vintage-consistent macro and sector credit data with publication/revision dates preserved
benchmark_seeds.oos_requirement: expanding-window country/sector evaluation with vintage reconstruction
benchmark_seeds.regime_holdout: hold out at least one financial-crisis or major policy-regime episode
benchmark_seeds.multiple_testing_risk: predeclare borrower sectors, transmission observables and primary macro endpoints

benchmark_seeds.target: price-implied cash-flow and discount-rate expectation decomposition with explicit residual and optional predictive qualification
benchmark_seeds.candidate_model: asset-routed present-value decomposition with frozen A0 asset form, A1 pricing archetype and model family
benchmark_seeds.pit_requirement: freeze predictor values, cash-flow expectations, rates and model inputs at historical publication time
benchmark_seeds.oos_requirement: true out-of-sample forecasting for any predictive claim; interpretation-only decomposition may be evaluated on reconstruction separately
benchmark_seeds.regime_holdout: hold out at least one major rate, inflation or valuation regime
benchmark_seeds.multiple_testing_risk: predeclare predictor family and distinguish interpretation metrics from prediction metrics

benchmark_seeds.target: realized liquidation horizon, slippage, gap loss and funding breach during stress windows
benchmark_seeds.candidate_model: multidimensional PIT stress-liquidity state using spread, depth, price impact, order size/ADV, volatility and funding/margin conditions
benchmark_seeds.pit_requirement: use only contemporaneously observable market microstructure and funding-condition data before the evaluated exit window
benchmark_seeds.oos_requirement: walk-forward stress-window evaluation with asset and order-size stratification
benchmark_seeds.regime_holdout: hold out at least one severe liquidity/funding stress episode
benchmark_seeds.multiple_testing_risk: predeclare liquidity dimensions, stress windows and order-size buckets

benchmark_seeds.target: realized return reconstruction and thesis-fidelity settlement against the immutable ResearchReceipt
benchmark_seeds.candidate_model: asset-form-routed attribution with arithmetic identity, factor/news components, explicit residual and immutable receipt comparison
benchmark_seeds.pit_requirement: freeze original position, benchmark, attribution question, factor/model set and ResearchReceipt before outcome review
benchmark_seeds.oos_requirement: evaluate attribution protocol on later realized outcomes without changing benchmark/model after seeing P&L
benchmark_seeds.regime_holdout: hold out at least one market regime or asset-form family not used to tune attribution choices
benchmark_seeds.multiple_testing_risk: freeze attribution question and primary model family before settlement; report alternate models as robustness only
